articles.summary: On Thursday, Nov. 5, 2026, the stock market behaved less like a forum for weighing the value of businesses and more like a forest laden with bundles of dry underbrush that caught fire, triggering a chain reaction that turned into a firestorm. Given the evolution of equity market structure, more rampantly escalating blazes should be expected. - 5 min read
articles.title: When the Machines Sell: Amplified Market Fragility and Why It Could Favor the Patient, Unlevered Investor
